channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Monday turned the capital question into filings. Anthropic's public S-1 shows it builds almost nothing itself and rents nearly everything: up to $120.5 billion with SpaceXAI into 2029, about $3.1 billion a month once capacity lands in December, a $125.2 billion five-year Broadcom accelerator lease that cannot be cancelled, $44.6 billion with Nscale and $41.3 billion with Lambda. Meta launched a $95 billion equity plan, $35 billion now and $60 billion at-the-market from 2027, with NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom offering to buy up to $5 billion of it. SpaceX filed a binding commitment for a $40 billion Apollo-managed GPU finance lease, and Elon Musk said debt markets have shut for neoclouds without other revenue; CoreWeave and Nebius fell about 4%. The neocloud rent in Anthropic's book carries conditions: Nscale must find financing and $34.9 billion of the Lambda deal falls away if Lambda cannot secure the facility lease. On the public tape, DigitalOcean cut AMD spot: MI355X to $2.97 from $5.50 and MI350X to $2.46 from $3.50. Everything else confirmed.

item.title: Compute brief - 26 October 2026
item.description: Monday turned the capital question into filings. Anthropic's public S-1 shows it builds almost nothing itself and rents nearly everything: up to $120.5 billion with SpaceXAI into 2029, about $3.1 billion a month once capacity lands in December, a $125.2 billion five-year Broadcom accelerator lease that cannot be cancelled, $44.6 billion with Nscale and $41.3 billion with Lambda. Meta launched a $95 billion equity plan, $35 billion now and $60 billion at-the-market from 2027, with NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom offering to buy up to $5 billion of it. SpaceX filed a binding commitment for a $40 billion Apollo-managed GPU finance lease, and Elon Musk said debt markets have shut for neoclouds without other revenue; CoreWeave and Nebius fell about 4%. The neocloud rent in Anthropic's book carries conditions: Nscale must find financing and $34.9 billion of the Lambda deal falls away if Lambda cannot secure the facility lease. On the public tape, DigitalOcean cut AMD spot: MI355X to $2.97 from $5.50 and MI350X to $2.46 from $3.50. Everything else confirmed. Countries: United States: Anthropic S-1: up to $120.5 billion SpaceXAI GPU compute into 2029, $125.2 billion Broadcom five-year accelerator lease, $44.6 billion Nscale, $41.3 billion Lambda (Wire, 26 Oct). United States: Meta $95 billion equity plan for AI infrastructure; four superclusters above 1 GW; data centers in 23 states; 2026 capex $135 to $145 billion (Wire, 26 Oct). United States: SpaceX binding commitment for an Apollo-managed GPU master finance lease, about $40 billion of principal, schedules from 1H 2027 (Wire, 24 Oct). South Korea: SK Hyper seeks about $350 billion for the first 5 GW of a 15 GW plan by 2035, starting with 900 MW in Ulsan; operations from 2029 (Wire, 23 Oct; financing not yet raised). United States: Texas TCEQ suspends at least 17 data center construction authorizations and shuts its online permit portal under the governor's pause (Wire, 22 Oct). United Kingdom: Treasury previews £60 million more for the Sovereign AI Fund and £18 million for a chip design academy in the Budget (Wire, 24 Oct).
